_comment: The city (#333, #220, part of #331): a European city of perimeter blocks beside the road. at: metres out from the start along the road; side: metres from the road's middle to the city's near edge (negative: the other side). size (metres, square), blocks (a side), street_width (kerb to kerb), street_jitter (how far, in metres, each street line may sit off a regular grid), pavement (width), passage_width (through each block into its courtyard), building_depth, floors_edge and floors_middle (storeys at the edge and toward the middle), style (danish for now; see #335). pad_blend: metres over which the levelled city eases back into the land. builds_per_frame: buildings put up each frame while the city loads.
